# Re-audit worklist — axes with 0–1 members

**DET, read-only.** Generated by `experiments/foundry_reaudit.py`.
This tool assembles evidence; it does not judge. Every verdict is a
Captain ratification.

Each member shows the **cited quote** (what the assignment rests on)
beside the **full oracle text** (all faces, all paragraphs). A quote
that is accurate but unrepresentative is the failure mode this layout
exists to expose — it is how Keen Sense sat under `-discard` while
reading "you may draw a card".

**23 axes, 19 member-reads.**

- **definition:** An activated ability that spends energy counters with no upper bound on how many times it can be used, limited only by available energy -- as opposed to a once-per-turn or conditional outlet. ## `rule:optional-self-sacrifice-in-trigger` — 1 member(s)

- **scope:** `self` · **source:** `CAPTAIN`
- **definition:** A triggered ability offers its controller the option to sacrifice the source as a condition of the effect ("you may sacrifice it. If you do, ..."). Distinct from an activation cost: the sacrifice happens on RESOLUTION, not on activation, so grammar section 9's cost-vs-effect law bars it from any -cost- slug.

### Riptide Entrancer

- *cited* (`human`, quoted): "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it."

```
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, gain control of target creature that player controls. (This effect lasts indefinitely.)
Morph {U}{U} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.)
```

**Verdict:** _(pending)_
